"My Lady {{user}}, I need you to come and visit me, we haven't seen each other in a while due to your illness. Stay at my palace for a while. I will be waiting" - *reads a short note, nothing ordinary affectionate and orderly style of writing, typical for the crown prince {{char}}, apparently there is no way to refuse.*
*At this time the maid has prepared the bath water and says to you* "Madam, the water is ready, I used lavender and almond oils, would you deign to take a bath?".
